metadata.docsJustification: Test-only change to private helpers in one test file; no doc in docs/, configuration/, reference/, CLAUDE.md, sync-sources/rules/ or the codebase map describes them. The in-file comments that explain each wait ship inside the code items (PRD Work item 7).

narratives.Problem: Main CI went red at cbb8ebefb9e (run 43969539204, test-shard 2/4) in tests/unit/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.test.ts. Every failing frame is a condition wait that ran out of turns (driveUntil's 100-turn cap at lines 573, 700, 919; drive(40, ...) at line 692), not a fixed drive. One turn yields about 1 ms of real time, while an admission needs 15-30 sequential fs ops, so on a loaded runner no turn count is safe. Eleven fixed drive(N) calls also remain. Some are real ordering races: line 963 failed under local load because legacyFitSince started after the clock jump. The rest are negative windows that pass vacuously on a slow host.
narratives.Proposal: Two parts, test-only. (1) Give every condition wait a 4 s real wall-clock budget (Date.now captured before fake timers start), raise the file's test timeout to 30 s with vi.setConfig, and give driveUntil a failure message that names the budget. (2) Replace each of the eleven fixed drives with a wait on a positive signal: the first onWaiting report, a pressure-sample or memory-read counter, or ticket state on disk (blockedSince, waitKind). Fake timers stay on and no real sleeps are added.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change under src/; the admission loop is correct
- No change to tests/unit/lib/deploy/reload-supersede.test.ts or its drive helper
- No new real sleeps and no turning off fake timers
- No change to vitest.config.ts (global testTimeout, retry, pool)
- No quarantine and no move to a *.slow.test.ts file
- No test removed, renamed, skipped or marked .only; the file keeps 48 tests
- No change to the readQualityGateQueue or sampleQualityGatePressure describes
- No changelog.d entry (not user-facing)

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the attempt caps as well as the fixed drives, though the issue blames only fixed drives
autoDecisions.rationale: The CI log for run 43969539204 shows every failing frame inside driveUntil (100-turn cap) or drive(40, ...); converting fixed drives alone would not have turned that run green. The local loaded repro failed at the same cap (line 693) and at a fixed-drive race (line 967), so both parts are needed.

autoDecisions.summary: Use a 4 s real wall-clock budget instead of the issue's example 200-turn cap
autoDecisions.rationale: Turns consumed per fs op grow with host load, so any fixed count only lowers the odds. A wall-clock bound returns on the first true turn, so fast hosts pay nothing; the issue's 200 was given as an example of a generous cap.

autoDecisions.summary: Raise the file's testTimeout to 30 s via vi.setConfig
autoDecisions.rationale: vitest.config.ts sets 5 s; several 4 s-budget waits per test would otherwise turn an assertion failure into a timeout. The same per-file pattern exists in feedback-target.test.ts and workflows.test.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Retire PAN-5394 NFR-1 (helpers unchanged) and remove drive's fixed-count form
autoDecisions.rationale: The helpers were the failing point. PAN-5394 D1's reason (non-asserting drive so the following assertion shows the real diff) is kept: drive(done) still never asserts.

autoDecisions.summary: Reorder site F so the clock advances only after the head records its memory block at t=1
autoDecisions.rationale: createdAt and memoryBlockedSince are read after `await mkdir`, so today they are usually 5000 and the test never checks its 'past the bound' case. The change matches its sibling test at line 838.

verify_commands: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.test.ts || exit 1; done

bash -c '
  driver=$$
  pids=""
  for i in $(seq 1 $(( $(nproc) * 2 ))); do
    sh -c "while kill -0 $driver 2>/dev/null; do :; done" &
    pids="$pids $!"
  done
  trap "kill $pids 2>/dev/null" EXIT
  for r in $(seq 1 10); do
    kill -0 $pids 2>/dev/null || { echo "load processes died before run $r"; exit 1; }
    OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0 timeout 140 npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/cloister/quality-gate-admission.test.ts || exit 1
    kill -0 $pids 2>/dev/null || { echo "load processes died during run $r"; exit 1; }
  done
'
